decisions.reason: Although strategically aligned and initially treated as a flagship, its absence from the website through 2020-2021 suggests results stayed below aspirations long enough that even a large firm's slack is no longer enough to justify keeping it.

A multi-model line that disappears from view after launch likely failed to meet aspiration levels relative to the core portfolio, so management would rationally redeploy resources to stronger packaging lines and new development.

Because this crate line was only lightly featured from the start and then not observed for two years, behavioral-theory logic points to a clear shortfall versus aspirations and a high likelihood of exit.

The spill-retention pallet appears to be a more peripheral niche for the firm, and continued non-observation indicates demand probably did not justify ongoing attention once performance was judged against internal and peer aspirations.

Even though this pallet variant fits existing capabilities, its disappearance from the website suggests weak enough uptake that management would likely fold resources back into established pallet products or newer projects.
